ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a high-contrast ratio of approximately 85:15 relative to high-intensity (white/grey) markings and clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is solid black. High-intensity white clusters are concentrated on the peripheral leading edges and distal tips. Dispersed, low-frequency linear white/grey markings are present across the central and inner regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels; right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced jaggedness compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges demonstrate a gradual concave sweep from the median notch to the tips; leading edges are convex and heavily modulated by high-intensity biological clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonization along the entire visible length of the leading edges and tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the dark ventral surface, with high density on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the right lobe surface; heavy barnacle encrustation creating a jagged, high-intensity perimeter on leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme concentration of barnacle growth on the leading edges creates a unique high-contrast white 'fringe' effect.
